title: Sopra Steria: proposed acquisition of Digital Product Simulation, an expert in digital simulation and PLM solutions.

title: Sopra Steria Group stock (FR0000050809): Revenue growth and sharp share-price rally draw attention from US investors.

title: Sopra Steria Group stock (FR0000050809): Revenue growth and sharp share price rally in focus.

title: Sopra Steria: completion of Starion and Nexova acquisitions.

title: Sopra Steria sales rebound on defence and consulting spend, driving up shares.
snippet: Sopra Steria, which competes with Capgemini and Accenture, is turning a new leaf under CEO Rajesh Krishnamurthy, betting on its strengths in public and defence sector solutions and its focus on European clients.

title: Bas Eijhusen appointed managing director of Central region at ilionx.
snippet: The 36-year-old Eijhusen joins from Sopra Steria (formerly Ordina), where he worked for over ten years.

title: Generative AI: Sopra Steria Next sets out the blueprint for scaling generative AI.
snippet: PARIS, April 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ - Sopra Steria Next today unveils the first publication from its CIO Compass, focused on scaling generative AI.
